name: fale-pdf
description: FaLe PDF – PDF, Dokumente, Tabellen und Präsentationen. Privat, offline, ohne Konto.

scripts.android:add: node scripts/vercel-build.mjs --native && npx cap add android && node scripts/cap-patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/vercel-build.mjs --native && npx cap sync android && node scripts/cap-patch-android.mjs
scripts.ios:add: node scripts/vercel-build.mjs --native && npx cap add ios --packagemanager CocoaPods && node scripts/cap-patch-ios.mjs && cd ios/App && pod install
scripts.ios:sync: node scripts/vercel-build.mjs --native && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/cap-patch-ios.mjs && cd ios/App && pod install
